description: Audit the Playwright test code for flake risks (hard waits, one-shot assertions instead of web-first ones, missing awaits, .only, force clicks, networkidle, element handles, layout selectors) and rank files by how flaky their tests have been in the run history. fix: true rewrites the mechanical ones, re-runs the touched files and restores them if the run fails.

config.description: playwright.config path or 1-based index, for the verify run

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the file path

fix.description: Rewrite the mechanical findings (web-first assertions, missing awaits, .only), re-run the touched files and restore them if the run fails

historyRuns.description: How many recent runs of the local history to weigh in (default 50)

limit.description: Max findings to list (default 50); the summary counts all

minSeverity.description: Report findings at or above this severity (default low)

projectRoot.description: Project directory; defaults to the server working directory

testDir.description: Audit only this directory (inside the project); defaults to the config testDir

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock limit for the verify run

verify.description: With fix: re-run the touched files (default true)

name: audit-tests

fix.description: the replacement line, when the fix is mechanical

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Audit tests for flake risks
